name: Edgar
source:
The Duke of the North was supposed to have a political marriage with Lucena, until he announced his surprising engagement to Rosalie. He is also vying for the throne, making him Lucena's nemesis. He is sharper than a winter icicle, but what's hiding behind his icy exterior?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3541340/Your_Crown_Is_Mine/]Steam[/url]]
